photos.title: File:Citigroup Center at 601 Lexington Avenue (1977) (A. Moore) - Flickr.jpg
photos.author: Andrew Moore from Johannesburg, South Africa
photos.description: The building is one of the most distinctive in New York's skyline, thanks to a 45° angled top and a unique stilt-style base necessitated by the positioning of St. Peter's Evangelical Lutheran Church in one of the corners. There is a great podcast on the building's design and scandal around 'structural integrity' at 99percentinvisible.org/episode/structural-integrity-2/
